items.summary:
14 seats. 4 courses. 1 elegant night under the stars. 🕯️ 

To kick off theeee beginning of this new era, the era of the New Wave, the era of in-person astrology events I’m hosting, I’m kicking this chapter off with an intimate astrology VIP Italian Gournet Dining Experience with me to chat all things connection, community and astrology. 

📆 When? 
in Los Angeles on Monday Nov 23rd 
7pm - 10:30pm 

🕯️ a seasonal four-course dinner by the most incredibly magical Chef, Barbara 🍷

🕯️I’ve rented out the entire restaurant to ourselves

🕯️Mini astrology + astrocartography lessons from me, between courses

🕯️Prizes, giveaways, live readings with me in-person 

🕯️ and one guest wins lunch with me the next day 💕

This isn’t a webinar. This isn’t an online course. This isn’t a lecture. 

I’m taking things offline this year. And bringing you the magic and aliveness of astrology in-person. ⚡️

Just you, me, and thirteen other cosmic-lovers at a beautiful candlelit table, in an elegant restaurant, the most authentic seasonal Italian….in real life.

There are only 14 seats. 

When they’re gone, the doors close.

🔗 Reserve your seat by commenting “DINNER” and I’ll send you the details, kindred spirit!

items.title: September Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A detailed look at the astrology forecast for September 2026, with astrologers Chris Brennan and Austin Coppock.

We spend the first hour talking about news and events that happened over the past month since our last forecast, and then in the second hour we get into the astrology of September.

In the first part of the news section we discuss the strikingly literal manifestations of the recent eclipses in Leo and Pisces, including devastating floods and the deaths of several prominent figures and monarchs. After that we address the recent controversy surrounding Steven Forrest.

In terms of the astrology of September, we open the month still coming out of the chaos of eclipse season and the recent Mars-Saturn square, but the first week of September offers some excellent electional opportunities while Mercury and Venus are still in their home signs of Virgo and Libra.

There is a major turning point and tone shift around the New Moon in Virgo on September 10, when Uranus stations retrograde in Gemini, and Mercury and Venus both change signs the same day.

The astrology culminates late in the month around the Full Moon in Aries on September 26, because right after that Mars moves into Leo and begins to oppose Pluto, while Venus slows down to station retrograde in Scorpio in early October.

Ultimately, late September acts as a preparatory phase, setting the stage and introducing the core themes for the intense Venus and Mars retrogrades that will dominate the next several months.

This is episode 547 of The Astrology Podcast.
